content.name: Hulk
content.description:
布鲁斯·班纳博士非常讨厌他的敌人（就像其他人一样）。众所周知，当他变身为不可思议的浩克时，他几乎无法说话。因此，他请你帮忙表达他的感受。

浩克非常喜欢电影《盗梦空间》（Inception），他的感情也如同电影中的梦境一样复杂。一共有 $n$ 层。第一层是 hate，第二层是 love，第三层又是 hate，依此类推……

例如如果 $n=1$，那么他的感受是“I hate it”；如果 $n=2$，则是“I hate that I love it”；如果 $n=3$，则是“I hate that I love that I hate it”，以此类推。

请你帮助班纳博士。
content.formatI: 输入仅一行，包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 100$），表示爱与恨的层数。
content.formatO: 输出班纳博士的感受字符串，占一行。

en.name: Hulk
en.description:
Dr. Bruce Banner hates his enemies (like others don't). As we all know, he can barely talk when he turns into the incredible Hulk. That's why he asked you to help him to express his feelings.

Hulk likes the Inception so much, and like that his feelings are complicated. They have $ n $ layers. The first layer is hate, second one is love, third one is hate and so on...

For example if $ n=1 $ , then his feeling is "I hate it" or if $ n=2 $ it's "I hate that I love it", and if $ n=3 $ it's "I hate that I love that I hate it" and so on.

Please help Dr. Banner.
en.formatI: The only line of the input contains a single integer $ n $ ( $ 1<=n<=100 $ ) — the number of layers of love and hate.
en.formatO: Print Dr.Banner's feeling in one line.
